population.note: share_of_readable is the figure the paper quotes: the denominator is the absence value of rows where the proxy can be read, those with ten team-games still to come. share_of_all_rows divides by every row.

note: Stints, not rows: one judgement per (player, team, season), mapped back onto its rows when the rates are computed. The proxy reads the rest of the season and is a sampling device and a post-hoc sensitivity only, never a roster rule.
